_comment: Edition of each web navigation route, and each API rights form without a navigation item, that matches no desktop MENU_DATA row through the menu catalog. edition: L/B/S/U/P/A/E or platform (always available). Consumed by web/scripts/generate-edition-table.mjs (slice N171).

/dashboard.reason: Home page after Open Company (the desktop MDI start screen).

/forms/form-layouts.reason: Web catalogue of the desktop form layouts, not a desktop menu.

/masters/conversions.reason: CONV_MAST has no desktop maintenance screen; only company create and refresh copy it (MS_COMPANY, MS_YEAR, MS_UPDATE).

/masters/customers.reason: Customer view of AC_MAST, the Party master (MS_ACCT modes).

/masters/designs.reason: DESIGN_MAST is maintained by MS_STYLE, the Style menu (Advance); formCatalog notes the shared Designs rights row.

/masters/diamond-sizes.reason: MS_STK_LIMIT Dm Size mode; the Dm Size menu is hidden (SM_VIEW N) and ItStk Limit is Enterprise.

/masters/einvoice-gsp.reason: GSP credentials used by the E Invoice menu.

/masters/franchise-accounts.reason: FAN_AC_MAST has no desktop maintenance screen; only company create and refresh copy it.

/masters/gold-rate.reason: Live rate source configuration feeding the daily rate.

/masters/item-weights.reason: ITM_WT_MAST is maintained by MS_STK_LIMIT (ItStk Limit, Enterprise).

/masters/messages.reason: Message templates of the WhatsApp and SMS menus (Basic and Standard).

/masters/print-formats.reason: Print format settings of the Setting menu.

/masters/rates.reason: RATE master behind the Daily Rate menu (MS_RATE).

/masters/states.reason: State list used by the Party master for GST state codes.

/masters/styles.reason: COL_MAST column captions and visibility, part of the Setting screens.

/masters/years.reason: Financial years list behind Year Create and Year Select.

/reports/account-balances.reason: A mode of the Ledger Report report menu.

/reports/area-outstanding.reason: A mode of the Party Os report menu.

/reports/area-wise-sales.reason: A mode of the Sales Report report menu.

/reports/bill-outstanding.reason: A mode of the Party Os report menu.

/txn/batch-receipt.reason: Multi-party receipt mode of TR_CASH (Cash and Bank Received).

/txn/estimate.reason: Estimate mode of TR_SALE (the page cites TR_SALE).

/txn/fine-inout.reason: TR_FN_INOUT (FINE INOUT book); the metal and amount in/out menus are Enterprise.

/txn/gold-book.reason: TR_GOLD_BOOK (digital gold) is opened from no MENU_DATA row (MDI_FORM.cs:9486); not in any edition menu.

/txn/item-lot.reason: TR_ITM_LOT is dispatched from Lot Opening (MDI_FORM.cs:7700-7715), an Advance menu hidden in MENU_DATA.

/txn/jobwork-issue.reason: Job-work (Jadtar) issue, TR_JDT_REC; MDI_FORM.cs:11230-11237 ties MsMfgType J/M to the Standard Mfg button.

/txn/journal.reason: Journal mode of TR_CONTRA, the form behind Contra Entry and Fine Jv Entry.

/txn/melting.reason: Melting voucher of the manufacturing family.

/txn/membership.reason: Loyalty points (POINT data); Point Mast and Point Report are Enterprise.

/txn/mfg-lot-issue.reason: Setting issue (MFG STNG ISU); reported by Lot IsuRec (Standard).

/txn/mfg-lot-receive.reason: Setting receipt (MFG STNG REC); reported by Lot IsuRec (Standard).

/txn/mfg-receive.reason: TR_MFG_ORD_REC receipt; reported by the Standard Mfg InOut and Mfg Ledger.

/txn/reminders.reason: Reminder list of UT_REMINDER (Reminder Entry, Basic).

/txn/stock.reason: Stock and tag browser over the Tag Stock report data.

/utilities.reason: Utilities hub page linking the utility screens.

/utilities/e-invoice.reason: IRN generation and cancellation for the E Invoice menu.

/utilities/hdd-registry.reason: UT_HDD registration, opened by the desktop before the company when no registration exists (MS_OPNCOMP.cs:616-620).

/utilities/user-request.reason: UT_USER_REQUEST; MDI_FORM.cs:11249-11254 shows it only in Enterprise, for administrators.

Masters/Diamond Sizes.reason: MS_STK_LIMIT Dm Size mode; hidden on the desktop, ItStk Limit is Enterprise.

Masters/Item Cities.reason: MS_STYLE Item City mode of the Style menu (Advance).

Purchase/Other Purchase.reason: Earlier name of the Other Expenses rights form (TR_OTH_PURC, Basic).

Reports/Physical Stock.reason: Physical stock report of the Physical Stock menu (Basic).
